messages:
Aisha: heads up — we're spinning up a small canary for the new quant-4b-ish variant; want the promptset trimmed to a 2k mini-batch that focuses on long-tail intents and hallucination-prone prompts.
Mike: ok. do you want strict dedupe or fuzzy? fuzzy will keep paraphrases for robustness.
Aisha: fuzzy dedupe please, threshold ~0.8. keep paraphrase families of size <= 5.
Sora: tagging in sampling constraints: prefer examples with high entropy under current baseline (>0.9) and also a bit of low-ctx-length (<80 tokens) long-tail.
Jules: can you drop the SQL query you used to pull entropy scores? saves me time.
Sora: here —
```sql
SELECT id, entropy_score, tokens
FROM prompt_bank
WHERE dataset = 'prod_prompts'
  AND created_at > '2025-01-01'
  AND entropy_score IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY entropy_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;
```
Aisha: perfect. we'll run a small stratified sample: 500 high-entropy, 300 mid, 200 low but long-tail.
label-bot: @Aisha sample created: sample_id=mini-canary-3667, 1000 items, dedupe=fuzzy-0.8, strat=H500_M300_L200.
Mike: labeling plan? do we want two-reviewer adjudication for the high-entropy slice?
Aisha: yes — two reviewers + curator adjudicator. high-entropy needs gold-assessment split.
Dana: quick note on golden: we'll need to refresh 120 golden items to include edge hallucinations specific to the new model's failure modes. I can start drafting updates to the golden rubric.
Jules: QA question — for canary metrics what thresholds should trigger rollbacks? latency ok but quality drop >3% LMCI on hallucination metric -> blocker.
Aisha: agree. also track token-efficiency regression >5% vs baseline for same prompt buckets.
Sora: on quantization experiment side: we're using q4_0 + a few per-layer tweaks. will log kernel differences and include per-sample mismatch traces.
Mike: do we want to run the canary in-hosted or dedicated? hosted gives faster iteration.
Aisha: start hosted, but with routing policy pin to dedicated if token cost spikes in first 30m.
label-bot: reviewers assigned: @dana, @mike for high-entropy; @jules, @sora for mid; @aisha for adjudication. ETA 48h.
Dana: putting together new golden rubric draft in the doc: includes explicit hallucination taxonomy (fabrication, incorrect entity, wrong time/sequence) and severity buckets.
Jules: also add a short reproducibility checklist: prompt seed, model variant, ctx length, deterministic flag, and kvcache state note.
Aisha: good call. add an entry to the canary ticket to capture failed-match examples for the quant mismatch heatmap.
Mike: small ops ask — can eng-runtime enable prefix-cache logging for the canary run (10k per-token traces)? will be noisy but helpful.
Sora: pinged eng-runtime. they said enable-only for 30m windows, will set retention to 24h.
Dana: labeling nuance — when annotating hallucination severity, use 'Likely harmful' tag only if output could cause safety/regulatory breach. otherwise 'quality'.
Jules: we should also record model confidence proxy (logit gap) per sample; helps correlate entropy vs hallucination.
Aisha: agreed. final checklist: sample pulled (done), dedupe fuzzy (done), reviewers assigned (done), golden rubric draft (in progress), runtime logging window set (pending confirmation), rollback SLOs documented (done).
Mike: I'll kick off the hosted canary at 13:00 UTC once eng-runtime confirms logging window.
label-bot: update: runtime logging enabled window 13:00-13:30 UTC for sample_id=mini-canary-3667.
Sora: starting preflight smoke now — running baseline vs quant variant on 200 quick prompts. posting quick diff when done.
Aisha: thanks all — let's keep async updates here. tag me if any reviewer needs adjudication earlier. :thumbsup:
